crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside…
Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet…
Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to…
Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and…
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first…

translations.web: He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
translations.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
translations.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
translations.asv: And he said unto them, O foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
